Methodologically situated within the combinatorial matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text systematically integrates the *Sanidassanattika* (triad of things with visible form) with the *Kenaciviññeyyaduka* (dyad of things cognizable by something), analyzing conditioning relations between these categorical phenomena [SuttaCentral].
